name: sec-opendata
description: Pull Thai SEC Open Data from api.sec.or.th across v1/v2 bond, fund, PVD, digital asset, Licence Check, One Report, and related endpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Set up SEC access, find funds offline, and fetch Thai market data.
interface.longDescription: Three skills and a Python CLI for SEC Open Data Thailand: sec-onboarding for local credential setup, sec-fund-search for offline fund/AMC discovery, and sec-open-api for live v1/v2 data across portal categories with bundled endpoint references.
defaultPrompt: Set up my SEC API key with sec-onboarding.
Find a Thai mutual fund by name without an API key.
Fetch a One Report financial statement.
List SEC portal API key scopes.
